rows.question: What does the L flag do in binfmt_misc?

It is for ELF binaries of a native architecture, and it runs the binary as a fully native exec. [1][3]

It rejects the classic-dispatch flags ``T``, ``P``, ``O`` and ``C`` at registration. [5]
